import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, pointbiserialr
x=pd.read_csv('sensors.csv')
y=pd.read_csv('labels.csv')
print('shapes',x.shape,y.shape)
print('labels',y.label.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
print('time', y.timestamp.min(), y.timestamp.max(), 'unique', y.timestamp.nunique())
print('missing per row quantiles',x.isna().sum(axis=1).quantile([0, .5,.9,.99,1]).to_dict())
print('all-null',x.columns[x.isna().all()].tolist())
print('constant', [c for c in x if x[c].dropna().nunique()<=1][:20], 'n',sum(x[c].dropna().nunique()<=1 for c in x))
rows=[]
for c in x.columns:
    a=x.loc[y.label==1,c].dropna(); b=x.loc[y.label==-1,c].dropna()
    if min(len(a),len(b))>=5 and a.nunique()>1 and b.nunique()>1:
      u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided')
      # cliff delta positive defect higher
      delta=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
      meddiff=a.median()-b.median()
      rows.append((c,len(a),len(b),a.median(),b.median(),meddiff,delta,p))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['sensor','ndef','ngood','med_def','med_good','median_diff','cliffs_delta','p']).sort_values('p')
print(r.head(30).to_string(index=False))
print('p<.01',sum(r.p<.01),'p<.05',sum(r.p<.05))
# missing association: proportions, fisher
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
miss=[]
for c in x:
  tab=pd.crosstab(y.label,x[c].isna()).reindex(index=[-1,1], columns=[False,True], fill_value=0)
  orr,p=fisher_exact(tab.values)
  miss.append((c,tab.loc[1,True]/tab.loc[1].sum(),tab.loc[-1,True]/tab.loc[-1].sum(),orr,p))
m=pd.DataFrame(miss,columns=['sensor','miss_def','miss_good','odds_ratio','p']).sort_values('p')
print('missing association top')
print(m.head(20).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
x=pd.read_csv('sensors.csv'); meta=pd.read_csv('labels.csv'); y=(meta.label==1).astype(int)
# test all valid, BH correction + direction auc
rec=[]
for c in x:
 a=x.loc[y==1,c].dropna(); b=x.loc[y==0,c].dropna()
 if a.nunique()>1 and b.nunique()>1:
  u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided'); auc=u/(len(a)*len(b))
  rec.append([c,p,auc,len(a),len(b)])
r=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=['sensor','p','auc_defect_higher','n_def','n_good'])
r['q_bh']=multipletests(r.p,method='fdr_bh')[1]
print('valid',len(r),'BH discoveries 5%',(r.q_bh<.05).sum(), 'min q',r.q_bh.min())
print(r.sort_values('p').head(15).to_string(index=False))
# Timing / defect rate by chronological decile
meta['time']=pd.to_datetime(meta.timestamp)
meta['block']=pd.qcut(meta.time,10,duplicates='drop')
print('\\nTime deciles')
print(meta.groupby('block', observed=True).label.agg(n='size',defects=lambda z:(z==1).sum(), defect_rate=lambda z:(z==1).mean()).to_string())
# associations by 5 time windows for top 9, exact signs/deltas
cands=r.nsmallest(9,'p').sensor.tolist()
meta['block5']=pd.qcut(meta.time,5,labels=False)
for c in cands:
 parts=[]
 for b in range(5):
  z=x.loc[meta.block5==b,c]; yy=y[meta.block5==b]; a=z[yy==1].dropna(); d=z[yy==0].dropna()
  if len(a)>=3 and a.nunique()>1 and d.nunique()>1:
   u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,d); delta=2*u/(len(a)*len(d))-1
   parts.append(f'{delta:+.2f}')
  else: parts.append('NA')
 print(c, 'block cliff deltas', ', '.join(parts))
# simple permutation min p 300 loops, maintains counts
rng=np.random.default_rng(20260917); arr=x.to_numpy(float); valid=[]
for j in range(arr.shape[1]):
 v=arr[:,j]; ok=np.isfinite(v)
 if ok.sum() and np.unique(v[ok]).size>1: valid.append(j)
obs=float(r.p.min()); mins=[]
for it in range(300):
 yp=rng.permutation(y.to_numpy())
 vals=[]
 for j in valid:
  v=arr[:,j]; aa=v[(yp==1)&np.isfinite(v)]; bb=v[(yp==0)&np.isfinite(v)]
  if len(aa)>1 and len(bb)>1:
   vals.append(mannwhitneyu(aa,bb).pvalue)
 mins.append(min(vals))
print('\\npermutation min p observed',obs,'null median',np.median(mins),'P(min<=obs)',(np.sum(np.array(mins)<=obs)+1)/(len(mins)+1),'null 5%',np.quantile(mins,.05))
# Spearman between time rank and candidate; global trend maybe confound
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
tr=meta.time.astype('int64')
for c in cands:
 ok=x[c].notna(); rho,p=spearmanr(tr[ok],x.loc[ok,c]); print('time',c,round(rho,3),f'{p:.2g}')
PY"
